response.notes: Stop bar and the stop-line section are clear. The upstream row lies entirely in a building shadow, so its kerb (right_x) is weakly supported: the band x~570-708 upstream probably holds a bike lane and/or on-street parking rather than extra motor lanes, and the road visibly widens to the right of the bulb-out kerb seen at the stop line. Whether the raised island still exists at y~1277 or has become a painted centre line cannot be confirmed in the shadow; the left limit is the same light edge either way. The dashed network line (x~489) runs through the target lanes, not along their left edge.
